$comment: The example messages of the one rule of what is a file of a message (Fehlerliste 0.9.0 C6). Held against both parsers: imapAttachmentRule.test.ts (the phone's, net/mime.ts) and mail_imap.rs (the desktop's). Change both, or neither.
